label: HATVP déclaration de patrimoine (presidential candidate)
detail: Declared net assets in her 29 March 2022 candidate declaration to the HATVP — her most recent published patrimony declaration. Composed mainly of real-estate/SCI shares plus modest liquid assets. DECLARED.

label: Real estate / SCI shares (2022 declaration)
detail: Public Sénat read the declaration as two declared properties worth EUR 677,684 plus EUR 616,800 in an SCI (Montretout). L'Essentiel de l'Éco itemised three SCI participations: 12.5% SCI Montretout = EUR 616,800; 28.5% SCI (≈120 m² house) = EUR 111,883; 25% SCI (≈382 m² house) = EUR 565,801. Framings are reconcilable. DECLARED. FLAG: reconcile SCI names against the raw HATVP PDF.

label: Life insurance (assurance-vie) and bank accounts
detail: Liquid assets in the 2022 declaration. DECLARED.

label: Motor vehicles
detail: No motor vehicle declared in the 2022 patrimony declaration. DECLARED 'none'.

label: HATVP patrimony declaration (revaluation, 2017 candidacy)
amount: SCI Montretout share revalued to EUR 312,500
detail: In her 2017 candidate filing she revalued her 12.5% SCI Montretout share to EUR 312,500 (up from ~EUR 225,000 declared in 2014) and declared the Millas property (50% via SCI, shared with Louis Aliot) at EUR 36,619. HISTORICAL / DECLARED.

label: HATVP / tax administration counter-estimate of real estate
detail: The HATVP referred her 2014 (MEP) declaration to the financial prosecutor for manifest undervaluation of real estate (~60% understatement). The Conseil d'État upheld the HATVP's 'insincere/inexact' finding on 19 July 2019. ESTIMATED (HATVP/fisc). Administrative finding, not a criminal conviction.

label: MEP remuneration (European Parliament, through June 2017)
amount: ~EUR 6,200 net/month base salary (package incl. allowances ~EUR 11,000/month gross)
detail: Standard MEP remuneration while she held the European mandate. From February 2017 the Parliament withheld part of her indemnity and her general-expenses allowance pending the fictitious-assistants investigation. DECLARED/reported.

label: Deputy's parliamentary indemnity (indemnité parlementaire)
detail: Net parliamentary indemnity reported in her HATVP deputy declaration. DECLARED.

label: Party remuneration as RN president
detail: Declared income of EUR 60,000 as RN president, maintained in 2021 even after Bardella became interim president. DECLARED.

label: Repayment ordered to the European Parliament
detail: The European Parliament ordered her to repay sums tied to the fictitious-assistants matter; she repaid close to EUR 330,000. HISTORICAL. Distinct from the criminal case.

label: Proceeds from sale of inherited Cannes apartment (SCI Santa Monica)
detail: Marine Le Pen became universal legatee of a 102 m² Cannes apartment (testament dated 5 Oct 2023); the SCI Santa Monica was dissolved in April 2024 and the apartment sold on 5 April 2024, with net proceeds credited to her personal account on 12 April 2024. Reported by Le Monde. Not reflected in her last published HATVP declaration. DECLARED via reporting / post-declaration event.

label: Estimated available patrimony (post-Cannes sale, post-inheritance)
detail: L'Essentiel de l'Éco estimated her available patrimony at ~EUR 2.28M in 2025 after the Cannes sale and her father's January 2025 estate; a higher ~EUR 4.3M figure circulates but is rejected by that source. ESTIMATED — not a HATVP declaration. FLAG: estimate only.
